messages:
Marta - Docs: opening a small docs PR to correct embedding precision guidance and an SDK auth snippet that points to the old KMS page. Not a blocker for the runtime release but want it clean in the catalog.
Sam - ML Eng: which model cards are we changing?
Marta - Docs: vega13b and polaris13b. The embedding section currently recommends "fp16 for embeddings" which is misleading for our embed-serving pipeline where int8 quantized variants are the default for cost-sensitive workloads.
Jules - SDK: that auth snippet was probably my paste from an older branch. Which file is linked wrong?
Marta - Docs: docs/sdk/snippets/auth.md links to /docs/security/kms-legacy. Should point to /security/kms-integration. Also small wording tweak in docs/models/vega13b.md and docs/models/polaris13b.md about batching guidance.
Tanya - QA: FYI the embed throughput test showed a big gap yesterday  default batch vs int8. We saw ~0.45 tok/ms with t4+int8 but ~1.1 tok/ms with a100+fp16 for the same prompt set.
Sam - ML Eng: sounds right. Proposed copy: "For embedding-only workloads we recommend quantized int8 variants together with a short batching window (e.g., 8-12ms). Typical observed throughput: t4 int8 ~0.3-0.5 tok/ms, A10G int8 ~0.6-0.9, A100 fp16 ~1.2-1.6. Results vary by sequence length and batch policy." Keep as guidance not guarantee.
Kiran - Product: add a one-liner about cross-region delta for small batches  customers see ~10-20% latency increase EU->US. Also mention watch for small changes in similarity scores when switching quantization.
Marta - Docs: will add the cross-region stat and an eval checklist for similarity drift (sample pairs, cosine delta threshold, business check).
Jules - SDK: I'll patch the auth snippet to point to the new KMS page and add a tiny python refresh example. Draft: 
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
if c.auth.needs_refresh():
    c.auth.refresh()
```
Let me know if we want a JS snippet too.
Sam - ML Eng: add a note: "cache tokens for high-QPS embedding calls".
Tanya - QA: I'll re-run the embedding harness against the int8 configs after the docs fix. ETA ~40m.
Marta - Docs: PR link: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/docs/pulls/4012  changes: wording on two model cards, one include update for KMS link, SDK snippet tweak.
doc-bot: CI started for PR #4012  linkcheck, snippets, docs-lint.
Jules - SDK: pushed fix for the link and added the python snippet + a tiny JS example. Force-pushed to branch.
Tanya - QA: linkcheck failed in CI due to an old include at docs/_includes/security_links.html referencing kms-legacy. I fixed locally and pushed.
Marta - Docs: updated the vega13b and polaris13b embed sections with the batching guidance, cross-region note, and the eval checklist. Also added a short cost/quality tradeoff paragraph.
Kiran - Product: approved the content changes from product side. Please mention "run a small eval on representative queries" in the checklist.
Sam - ML Eng: approved the model-specific benchmark numbers. Reminder: mark the table as "representative".
doc-bot: CI passed for PR #4012  all checks green.
Jules - SDK: can someone approve the snippet update?
Tanya - QA: approved  ran snippet-tests and the embed harness cross-region check. Observed median 12% EU->US latency bump for 8-16 item batches; added comment on PR.
Marta - Docs: merged to main. I'll add a short blurb to next week's changelog and ping support about customers on old KMS docs. Thanks everyone! :tada:
